snippet.title: Fun of Legends
snippet.description:
Bringing you the highest quality, edited clips of people you love to watch with unique experience!

All of my videos are created by me primarily using the editing programs After Effects, Cinema 4D and of course Photoshop. I swap heads, change backgrounds, overlay images and hire professional voice artists to help create new stories. 

All of my videos are created with one purpose in mind. To make you smile. I have a massive love for the game so tend to focus on funny unique makings rather than the classic copy paste videos.

If you enjoy my work then check out  my  videos where I go into detail about the effects work involved. I put a lot of effor into edits for a long time and with my outro I am trying to be the best editor that I could be myself.
